what: Shopify's Singapore requirements page states a verification deadline outside Europe and the UK, in the FAQ 'How long do I have to finish verifying my account?': 'For Shopify Payments Singapore specifically, accounts must be verified within 120 days from the day that you accept the terms of service and create the account.' and 'If you do not complete verification after 120 days your Shopify Payments account will not be able to process new orders moving forward.
